name: io.github.Klievan/jlink-mcp
title: J-Link MCP
description: Debug embedded firmware on real hardware: J-Link probes, Cortex-M faults, RTT logs, GDB.

environmentVariables.name: JLINK_DEVICE
environmentVariables.description: Target device name, exactly as J-Link spells it (e.g. nRF52840_XXAA, STM32F407VG). Use the search_devices tool to find it.

environmentVariables.name: JLINK_SERIAL
environmentVariables.description: Serial number of a specific probe, when more than one is attached.

environmentVariables.name: SVD_PATH
environmentVariables.description: CMSIS-SVD file for the target. Without it, peripheral reads are undecoded hex.

environmentVariables.name: JLINK_RTT_ADDR
environmentVariables.description: Address of the firmware's _SEGGER_RTT symbol. Lets RTT survive a reset or flash.
